stories.title: EN DIRECT - Jordan Bardella répond à Emmanuel Macron sur l’antisémitisme : «Après le 7 octobre 2023, j’ai marché dans les rues de Paris, pas lui»

en.title: Jordan Bardella responds to Emmanuel Macron on antisemitism: "After October 7, 2023, I walked in the streets of Paris, not him"
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron called on National Rally leaders to clarify their party's direction, values, and membership after antisemitic messages attributed to party president Jordan Bardella were published. Bardella responded with a counter-accusation about their respective actions following October 7, 2023.

stories.title: Vol de FlyDubai vers Tel-Aviv dérouté : les raisons de l'altercation en plein vol restent "inconnues", selon le porte-parole de la compagnie

en.title: FlyDubai flight diverted from Tel-Aviv: reasons for in-flight altercation remain "unknown", according to airline spokesman
en.summary: A FlyDubai flight heading to Israel was diverted when it rapidly lost altitude near the Jordanian border due to an incident involving one of the pilots. The exact cause of the altercation remains unclear.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Avion de Flydubai vers Tel-Aviv dérouté : Benyamin Netanyahou accuse l’un des pilotes d’avoir voulu provoquer un crash

en.title: EN DIRECT - FlyDubai plane diverted from Tel-Aviv: Benjamin Netanyahu accuses one of the pilots of attempting to cause a crash
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft heading to Tel-Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia following an in-flight incident. Israeli media reported an altercation between the pilots, with Netanyahu claiming one pilot attempted to provoke a crash.

stories.title: Ecrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : Emmanuel Macron juge "gravissimes et inacceptables" les propos rapportés par Mediapart

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: Emmanuel Macron deems reported remarks "serious and unacceptable"
en.summary: President Macron described antisemitic statements attributed to Jordan Bardella as serious and unacceptable. He also expressed concern about violence in the presidential campaign, which he warned could escalate tensions.

stories.title: Avion pour Tel-Aviv dérouté en Arabie Saoudite : ce que l’on sait de l’incident à bord d’un vol Flydubai

en.title: Plane to Tel-Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia: what we know about the incident on board a Flydubai flight
en.summary: A Flydubai aircraft flying from Dubai to Israel made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia on Wednesday following a sudden loss of altitude. Israeli media outlets reported claims of pilot altercation or possible terrorism, though circumstances remain unclear.

stories.title: Vol dérouté, pilotes blessés, piste terroriste évoquée... Ce que l'on sait de l'atterrissage d'urgence d'un avion FlyDubai à destination de Tel-Aviv

en.title: Diverted flight, injured pilots, terrorist plot mentioned... What we know about the emergency landing of a FlyDubai plane bound for Tel-Aviv
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft from Dubai to Tel-Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday morning. The Israeli government characterized the incident as an attempted jihadist terrorist attack.

stories.title: Ecrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : "Après le 7 octobre 2023, j'ai marché dans les rues de Paris, pas lui", répond le président du RN à Emmanuel Macron

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "After October 7, 2023, I walked in the streets of Paris, he didn't", responds the RN president to Emmanuel Macron
en.summary: Jordan Bardella, president of the National Rally party, responded to Emmanuel Macron by referencing his participation in an antisemitism march held in Paris on November 12, 2023, organized at the call of Senate and National Assembly leaders.

stories.title: Écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : Emmanuel Macron juge les propos «gravissimes et inacceptables» et appelle le RN à «clarifier»

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: Emmanuel Macron judges the remarks "extremely serious and unacceptable" and calls on the RN to "clarify"
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron described reported antisemitic statements attributed to Jordan Bardella as extremely serious and unacceptable, calling for the most severe condemnation and asking the National Rally party to clarify the matter.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella accusé d’antisémitisme : Emmanuel Macron critique des propos «gravissimes et inacceptables»

en.title: Jordan Bardella accused of antisemitism: Emmanuel Macron criticizes "extremely serious and unacceptable" comments
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron responded on September 30 to Mediapart revelations about antisemitic remarks, calling on the National Rally party to clarify the situation.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron juge les propos antisémites imputés à Jordan Bardella « gravissimes et inacceptables » ; le président du RN lui répond

en.title: Emmanuel Macron judges antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella "extremely serious and unacceptable"; National Rally president responds
en.summary: From Madrid, the French president responded to a Mediapart investigation documenting antisemitic statements made by Bardella during his youth in the National Front, while the National Rally leader countered by highlighting his own presence in Israel.

stories.title: Propos antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : le RN fait bloc

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella: the National Rally stands united
en.summary: Mediapart reported antisemitic statements and writings attributed to Jordan Bardella, who responded by claiming the objective is to destroy him politically while the National Rally party presents a unified defense.

stories.title: "On dirait qu'il joue un double jeu" : dans la communauté juive, peu de soutien pour Jordan Bardella après les propos antisémites révélés par Mediapart

en.title: "It seems he's playing a double game": little support for Jordan Bardella within the Jewish community following antisemitic remarks revealed by Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart's revelations about antisemitic comments have triggered mixed reactions within the Jewish community, ranging from anger to skepticism about their authenticity, with few expressing support for Bardella.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : les chiffres toujours plus inquiétants des finances publiques

en.title: Budget 2027: increasingly concerning figures for public finances
en.summary: France's debt has surpassed 3,500 billion euros, representing 119% of GDP. Rising interest rates driven by Middle Eastern energy tensions are expected to significantly increase interest charges by 2030.

en.title: Sabena Aerospace opens its capital
en.summary: Investment firm Andera Partners has decided to acquire a stake in Belgian aerospace maintenance company Sabena Engineering to support its expansion.

stories.title: Chez les sénateurs écolos, un « non » à LFI pas si consensuel que ça

en.title: Among Green senators, a "no" to LFI not as consensual as all that
en.summary: Green Party senators have declined to admit Gabriel Amard, a senator from La France insoumise, into their parliamentary group due to lack of consensus.

stories.title: Budget : « L’état de nervosité des marchés se matérialise par l’écart de taux entre la France et l’Allemagne »

en.title: Budget: "Market nervousness is reflected in the interest rate spread between France and Germany"
en.summary: ING Belgium's chief strategist was interviewed to explain market sentiment and expectations regarding the government's upcoming budget presentation.

stories.title: « Leasing pompes à chaleur » : les industriels prêts à élargir l’offre au-delà des foyers modestes

en.title: "Heat pump leasing": manufacturers ready to expand offer beyond modest households
en.summary: Consortiums of industrial, energy, and financial companies selected by the government for a social heat pump leasing program plan to extend similar offerings to all French households.
